meta.title: Vendor rejects the counter offer — buyer QCS shows rejected tag
gaps: The vendor rejecting the pending counter offer in the supplier portal
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The vendor rejecting the pending counter offer in the supplier portal

plan.title: Vendor rejects counter offer and buyer QCS shows rejection

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ stage can be configured.
Configure the event as an RFQ rather than the default auction.
Add the RFQ line item required for bidding.
Invite the vendor who will bid and receive the counter offer.
Publish the RFQ so the vendor can submit a quote.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit the vendor's original RFQ quote.
Confirm the vendor bid was accepted.
Open the buyer's comparison grid for the submitted bid.
Send a buyer counter offer against the vendor's live bid.
Confirm the QCS records the pending counter offer.

args.need: sign in as the vendor and reject the pending counter offer

steps.note: No catalog step can reject a counter offer from the vendor side.
Return to the buyer's RFQ QCS after the vendor rejection.
Verify the vendor's QCS column shows the required rejection tag.
